layouts.name: Japanese SG — questions with inline answers
layouts.description: Text-based Japanese question collections with annual/subject sections and an answer plus explanation after each question (layout1).
layouts.answerPattern: ^問\s*([0-9０-９]+)\s*[:：]\s*正答\s*([アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソ]+)\s*$
layouts.optionPattern: ^([アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソ])[ \t　]+(.+)$
reviewNotes: Namespace IDs by material, year/sample edition, subject and printed question number; question numbers restart.
Preserve Japanese option IDs. A combination such as ア = (一), (三) is one choice, not a multiple-choice answer.
Join cross-page stems and explanations; check diagrams, option tables and case-study passages against the page images.

layouts.name: Japanese SG — scanned textbook and separate answer keys
layouts.description: Image-only Japanese textbooks containing chapter examples, mock/sample questions, answer tables and separate explanations (layout2).
layouts.optionPattern: ^([アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソ])[ \t　]+(.+)$
reviewNotes: Use PDF bookmarks and original pages to define separate example/mock/sample and subject scopes. Never interpret textbook Q&A or the contents as exam questions.
Match question and explanation headers by scoped printed number, never position. Independently check the answer tables and report disagreements.
OCR may lose boxed 問 labels, confuse イ/エ and omit table cells. Every candidate requires visual review; absent or ambiguous answers stay withheld.
Keep shared case material with each subquestion. Do not infer free-text answers from a missing option table.

layouts.name: Japanese SG — Subject B case studies
layouts.description: Subject B cases with shared cross-page passages, structured tables, figures and independently keyed subquestions. Compiles reviewed cases into standard import JSON.
layouts.optionPattern: ^([アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソ])(?:[ \t　]+(.+)|[ \t　]*$)
reviewNotes: Preserve shared case material once in the inventory; the builder includes it in every subquestion stem.
Represent table headers and rows explicitly. Image-dependent material requires a reviewed sufficient text description or remains withheld.
Use case-scoped subquestion IDs. Never distribute one parent answer across multiple subquestions.
Combination answer rows remain single-choice when the source selects one kana option. Missing table cells or uncertain subquestion boundaries require review.
